instruction: Keep Dashboard destination cards non-navigational, retain concise visa pathway information inside the existing Destinations parent panel, establish Progress by planning area, Active pathway, and Deadlines and blockers as the default second Dashboard column, extend Account → Dashboard into an interactive drag-and-drop layout builder with optimized templates for all Dashboard panels including Journey, replace the completed-profile Flutter Mode header CTA with a plan-aware upgrade section, and audit/fix Dashboard Norman-door affordance problems without changing underlying business logic.
objective: Give each user one persisted Dashboard layout contract with two reorderable columns, explicit panel affordances, plan-aware upgrade access, optimized templates, and Journey placement while preserving existing match, pathway, Journey, profile, and plan logic.
allowedUIRegions: Dashboard header greeting and plan action
requiredChanges: Dashboard destination image cards do not navigate to country pages
visa pathway preview stays below matched cards inside the Destinations parent panel
visa pathway preview rows are informational and use one explicit Pathways navigation control
default second column contains Progress by planning area, Active pathway, and Deadlines and blockers
Account Dashboard tab supports native drag and drop between primary and second columns with accessible button alternatives
all Dashboard panels can be shown or hidden and rearranged
Journey tracker participates in customization and can remain the default header dropdown or become a Dashboard panel
existing saved v1 layouts migrate safely to the v2 layout contract
completed-profile Dashboard header no longer promotes Enter Flutter Mode
plan-aware upgrade section links explicitly to Account Billing
stale first-visit walkthrough target is replaced with a current Dashboard surface
ambiguous Active pathway link labels are made explicit
forbiddenChanges: Journey stage or task calculation changes
Dashboard panel content rewrites unrelated to layout, upgrade access, or affordance clarity
